# pangolin_user_devices (Data Source)

Lists the user-bound devices for an organization — phones, laptops, browsers, anything with a per-user binding. Distinct from `pangolin_clients` (org-level OLM clients with no user association).

All filter attributes are optional; when omitted, the upstream applies its defaults (`page_size = 20`, `status = ["active", "pending"]`, `order = "asc"`).

> **Note:** the item shape is inferred from the sibling `GET /org/{org}/clients` endpoint (same `Client` OpenAPI tag, same "Clients retrieved successfully" message). The `sites` field is intentionally omitted until a real value is observed — its element shape can't be guessed safely from spec alone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All active and pending devices (the upstream default filter).
data "pangolin_user_devices" "all" {}

# Top 10 mobile devices by outbound traffic.
data "pangolin_user_devices" "mobile_top" {
  status  = ["active"]
  agent   = "android" # repeat with "ios" or use a for_each to fan out
  sort_by = "megabytesOut"
  order   = "desc"
}

# Devices currently online for a given user.
data "pangolin_user_devices" "alice_online" {
  query  = "alice"
  online = true
  status = ["active"]
}

output "fleet_summary" {
  value = {
    total_active_pending = data.pangolin_user_devices.all.total
    alice_online_count   = data.pangolin_user_devices.alice_online.total
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent` (String) Filter by device agent. One of `windows`, `android`, `cli`, `olm`, `macos`, `ios`, `ipados`, `unknown`.
- `online` (Boolean) Filter by online status.
- `order` (String) Sort order. One of `asc`, `desc`. Default: `asc`.
- `query` (String) Free-text query filter.
- `sort_by` (String) Sort field. One of `megabytesIn`, `megabytesOut`.
- `status` (List of String) Filter by device approval / lifecycle status. Each entry is one of `active`, `pending`, `denied`, `blocked`, `archived`. Default: `["active", "pending"]`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Device list (current page). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `total` (Number) Total number of devices matching the filters (across all pages).

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (String) Device agent. One of `windows`, `android`, `cli`, `olm`, `macos`, `ios`, `ipados`, `unknown`. Null when unknown.
- `approval_state` (String) Approval state when device approval is enabled. Null otherwise.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the device is archived.
- `blocked` (Boolean) Whether the device is blocked.
- `client_id` (Number) The numeric client ID.
- `megabytes_in` (Number) Cumulative inbound traffic in MB. Null when the counters haven't been populated yet.
- `megabytes_out` (Number) Cumulative outbound traffic in MB. Null when the counters haven't been populated yet.
- `name` (String) Device display name.
- `nice_id` (String) Human-readable device ID.
- `olm_archived` (Boolean) Whether the underlying OLM tunnel is archived.
- `olm_version` (String) OLM agent version when applicable. Null otherwise.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the device is currently online.
- `org_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `org_name` (String) Display name of the parent organization.
- `pub_key` (String) Wireguard public key. Null when the device hasn't completed handshake.
- `subnet` (String) The device's assigned subnet.
- `type` (String) Connection type — `olm` for org-level connectors, otherwise an end-user device type.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the bound user. Null for org-level devices.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user this device is bound to. Null for org-level devices.
- `username` (String) Username of the bound user. Null for org-level devices.
